value.rationale: For dynamic Hutchinson trace differences, cheap common signed-coordinate actions preserve Rademacher probes and the paired evaluation count. The natural question whether such actions can realize a best possible joint coupling has a complete low-dimensional answer and a sharp first strict SPD obstruction; the matrix conditioning can tend to one, excluding an ill-conditioning-only explanation. The 3/2 gap is exact for a specified pair, not a universal performance ratio; use in a matrix-free algorithm is not claimed.
